_comment: Forefathers Steaks menu data. Per-ingredient nutrition values for Steak, Chicken, Cheese Wiz, American, Provolone, Mozzarella, and Kale Slaw are computed from the client-provided spreadsheet (Forefathers.xlsx, Menu sheet, rows 33-78) — these are CONFIRMED. Other ingredients (veggies, sauces, bread base) are USDA FoodData Central estimates pending client confirmation; flagged in DECISIONS.md. Formats use sizeMultiplier (Mini 0.6×, Regular 1.0×, Large 1.5×) to scale ingredient portions per the spreadsheet's per-size portion table. Yellow-highlighted ingredients in the xlsx (Fry Sauce, Spicy Blue Cheese, Ranch, Jalapeño Cilantro Ranch, Kale Slaw, Romaine/Spring Mix, Kale/Spring Mix, Corn Relish) are batch recipes documented in the Batch Recipes tab.
